entries.contract: Authentic broker admission, supervised-child lifecycle and conversation events must be composed separately in Phase 2.
entries.invariant: Preserve stale-generation fencing, callback ownership and proven shutdown settlement without making on_message-style synthetic records execution authority.
entries.reason: Removed OdinBot transport client, generation-bound dispatch/on_ready/on_message/guild reconciliation and transport lifecycle rather than emulate Discord in Desktop.
entries.replacement: Removed transport, no executable replacement in Phase 1. src/discord/wiring.py and src/__main__.py are hard gates; src/desktop authority primitives do not implement the broker or durable conversation sinks.

entries.contract: Desktop navigation must authorize the owner/conversation/report and operate saved projections without rerunning a producer.
entries.invariant: Foreign conversation controls deny access, duplicate report IDs forbid replay, and navigation never implies artifact/event publication.
entries.reason: Removed ScheduledReportPagination.on_raw_reaction_add and Cog setup, which routed platform reaction payloads to managed report controls.
entries.replacement: Neutral saved-page navigation implemented by ScheduledReportPaginationService.store_projection/project_page in src/discord/scheduled_report.py. Authenticated UI controls and durable publication remain Phase 2 blocked; post raises.

entries.contract: Any Phase 2 destructive confirmation must bind authentic owner, exact operation/target/revision and expiry with revocation rechecks.
entries.invariant: Foreign callers cannot confirm; timeout/cancel never becomes affirmative authority and stale/replayed confirmation cannot authorize a new effect.
entries.reason: Removed ConfirmView Discord buttons, author-ID interaction checks and timeout-as-cancel rather than treating a renderer click as authenticated confirmation.
entries.replacement: No confirmation UI/service replacement implemented in Phase 1. Broker-issued operation-specific confirmation remains Phase 2 work, not approved by this removal record.

entries.contract: Desktop must independently validate signed/package-aware bundles, update/rollback and supervised-core handoff in Phase 2.
entries.invariant: Do not infer Desktop safety from server unit/nfpm workflow validity or reintroduce independent service resurrection/install-tree mutation.
entries.reason: Removed parse_systemd_unit/validate_service_file, maintainer shell-script/nfpm validators and server GitHub Docker/deb workflow validation; these encode the server distribution rather than Desktop packages.
entries.replacement: src/packaging/__init__.py is an inert deferred namespace and register_self_update is blocked. No claim of an implemented or validated signed Desktop release/update pipeline.

entries.contract: Desktop owner authority must come from profile-bound issued context and real broker/OS-peer provenance, with private durable identity/session publication and revocation.
entries.invariant: No matching owner string, empty caller, tier or loopback address grants authority; corrupt/foreign/non-durable identity denies access and scopes never widen inherited policy.
entries.reason: Removed ApiTokenIdentity/TokenAuthSnapshot and remote token CRUD/resolve/inventory/last-credential publication policy instead of retaining multi-user bearer-token authority.
entries.replacement: Profile identity and runtime-bound OwnerAuthority/PermissionManager primitives are implemented in src/desktop and permissions; authentic OS-peer broker admission/session issuer and durable sinks remain Phase 2 blocked. Unit fixtures passing peer_uid explicitly are not OS-peer integration proof.
